test robust median on a stable subset

The series has unstable ranking and strong trend dominance; a weighted combination on the full pool with a different weight scheme may improve robustness. I will test a weighted pool_full using the existing weight handle w1, which was created by a previous inverse_error weighting but may differ in shrinkage or per-horizon application.

decision.justification: Selected 'trimmed_mean on pool4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9617. Series context: trend strength 0.9108 and seasonal strength 0.0; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.002); 1 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.241.
